description: This PHP class defines the LeavePeriodService in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing leave periods, including retrieving current leave periods, generating leave period lists based on historical data, and handling date calculations related to leave periods.

classes.name: LeavePeriodService
classes.description: A service class in OrangeHRM responsible for managing leave periods, including retrieval, generation, and date calculations related to leave periods.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of LeavePeriodDao, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getListOfMonths
methods.description: Returns an array of month names for the year.

methods.name: getMonthNumberList
methods.description: Returns an array of integers representing all months (1 to 12).

methods.name: getListOfDates
methods.description: Returns an array of valid dates for a given month, considering whether it's a leap year.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Fetches the latest leave period start date and month, with optional cache reload.

methods.name: _getLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of leave period history, with cache control.

methods.name: getGeneratedLeavePeriodList
methods.description: Generates a list of leave periods between start and end dates, based on historical data and optional 'toDate'.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodByDate
methods.description: Returns the leave period that includes the specified date.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period if leave period is defined.

methods.name: getNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Returns the normalized representation of the current leave period.

methods.name: getMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Provides the maximum permitted end date for leave periods if defined.
